decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service builds on the firm's owned fibre network. It was promoted to the home page in 2019, which suggests it met aspirations, and it fits the strategic move toward high-bandwidth infrastructure, so it does not trigger problemistic search.

The number ordering portal is a low-cost software tool that supports the established voice business. It was only mentioned, never featured, but it uses little slack and simplifies provisioning, so keeping it is reasonable even though voice services are being pruned.
